description: This file contains mock API implementation functions for frontend development, simulating backend responses for various endpoints such as jobs, applications, tests, challenges, notifications, and mentor messages. It imports mock data for these endpoints and provides an async API handler function.

methods.name: jsonResponse(data)
methods.description: Creates a Promise resolving to the provided data, mimicking an API response format.

methods.name: parseBody(options)
methods.description: Parses the body from the options object, handling JSON strings and objects.

methods.name: mockApi(path, options = {})
methods.description: Main exported function that handles different API paths and methods, returning mock data accordingly.
